content.title: Norfolk Saint Patrick's Day Parade
content.text: 59th Annual Saint Patrick's Day ParadeMarch 14, 2026 PARKING REMINDER FROM THE CITY OF NORFOLK: Parking on the uncurbed median will be allowed beginning Thursday, March 12 at 5 p.m. Interested in Volunteering? We are looking for parade lineup volunteers. Please Contact Us or call 757.587.3548. Participation Form Have a group that wants to be a part of this year’s parade? Fill out the form, print it, and send it in by February 1, 2026. Parade Route & Parking The parade begins at Northside Middle School. From that point, it travels North on Granby, turns left at A View Ave, turns left on First View Street, and ends at the intersection of First View and Government Ave.The parade route is approximately 1.5 miles. Your 2026 Grand Marshal Norfolk Community Leader, Lawyer, and grandson of Irish Immigrants, Charles “Chuck” McPhillips, will be the Grand Marshal of the 2026 parade! Photo Galleries Weather Updates Check back here for weather updates. Generally, the parade will go on in light rain. Shamrock Shenanigans March 7, 2026 | 6:30 p.m. – 11:00 p.m.Ticketed eventA celebration dinner and dance will be held on March 7, 2026 at the Columbian Club of Ocean View, Inc. This dance is being produced by Norfolk Parade, Inc. Tickets are $35.00 and include food, non-alcoholic drinks, and beer. For tickets, contact Barry Clark Jr at 757-635-2383. March 14, 2026 | 10:00am – noonPublic eventThe 59th annual St. Patrick’s Day Parade is a fun filled Irish parade with all the marching bands, clowns, floats, cars, and people necessary to make up an exciting and enjoyable parade. Everyone is Irish both in and along the parade route. Please check the parade map to see the parade route. The parade is presented by Norfolk Parade, Inc. After Parade Party March 14, 2026 | 12:00 p.m. – 4:00 p.m.Open to the Public (21 and up) After the parade come and join us inside the Columbian Club of Ocean View for live music, food, and fun. There will be a variety of food vendors and live music. This years bands will be: The Tiki Bar Band (inside the Hall) and The Janitors (outside). The party is held immediately following the parade and is hosted by The Columbian Club of Ocean View. 211 W. Government Ave, Norfolk, VA. Sponsors The parade would not be possible without the support of our sponsors.Interested in being a sponsor?Send us a message by completing the contact form below.
